name: karma-ember-native-launcher
description: Karma browser launcher for `nativescript test android`/`nativescript test ios`, used by Ember Native's own test suite. A patched fork of NativeScript's karma-nativescript-launcher (Apache-2.0) that reports its own launcher id back to karma on device registration, fixing a bug where `singleRun` never completes and the test process hangs forever after the last test finishes.
author: Patrick Pircher
